declare
 v_local_time date;

begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);

 else

 show_error('12060');

 end if;
end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_lov boolean;
BEGIN
IF :ctrl_blk_1.driveid is NOT NULL THEN
BEGIN
 SELECT a.drive_id
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.driveid
 FROM drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c 
 WHERE c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and a.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and b.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and c.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and a.status = 'CNFRM' 
 and ( c.name like '%' || :ctrl_blk_1.driveid || '%' 
 or a.drive_id = :ctrl_blk_1.driveid)
 and drive_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date ;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_drive_id');
 IF NOT v_lov THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
END;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 Dummy_Define VARCHAR2(1);
 --
 -- Begin DRIVE_BAGS detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR DRIVE_BAGS_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM DRIVE_BAGS 
 WHERE DRIVE_ID = :DRIVES.DRIVE_ID and CHAPTER_ID = :DRIVES.CHAPTER_ID;
 --
 -- End DRIVE_BAGS detail declare section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DRIVE_PROCEDURES detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR DRIVE_PROCEDURES_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM DRIVE_PROCEDURES 
 WHERE DRIVE_ID = :DRIVES.DRIVE_ID and CHAPTER_ID = :DRIVES.CHAPTER_ID;
 --
 -- End DRIVE_PROCEDURES detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin DRIVE_BAGS detail program section
 --
 OPEN DRIVE_BAGS_cur; 
 FETCH DRIVE_BAGS_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DRIVE_BAGS_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DRIVE_BAGS_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DRIVE_BAGS_cur;
 --
 -- End DRIVE_BAGS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DRIVE_PROCEDURES detail program section
 --
 OPEN DRIVE_PROCEDURES_cur; 
 FETCH DRIVE_PROCEDURES_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DRIVE_PROCEDURES_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DRIVE_PROCEDURES_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DRIVE_PROCEDURES_cur;
 --
 -- End DRIVE_PROCEDURES detail program section
 --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin DRIVE_BAGS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:DRIVES.DRIVE_ID is not null) or (:DRIVES.CHAPTER_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('DRIVES.DRIVES_DRIVE_BAGS'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DRIVE_BAGS'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DRIVE_BAGS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DRIVE_PROCEDURES detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:DRIVES.DRIVE_ID is not null) or (:DRIVES.CHAPTER_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('DRIVES.DRIVES_DRIVE_PROCEDURES'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DRIVE_PROCEDURES'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DRIVE_PROCEDURES detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
v_temp varchar2(2000);
query_cnt number:=0;
BEGIN
 ---:drives.s_select:='N';
 begin
 select name,a.sponsor_id
 into :drives.s_sponsor ,:drives.sponsor_id
 from drive_sponsors a,sponsors b where 
 a.drive_id=:drives.drive_id and 
 b.sponsor_id=a.sponsor_id and
 a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum=1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;

 select initcap(first_name)||' '||initcap(last_name)
 into :drives.rec_name
 from employees
 where staff_no = :drives.recruiter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :drives.rec_name := null;
 end;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 POST;
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PROCEDURE insert_defaults IS
 d_list varchar2(150);
 t_cnt number;
 t_overwrite number := ALERT_BUTTON3;
 t_prog varchar2(30) := 'DEFAULT';
 t_date date;
 cursor not_updated is
 select drive_id from drive_bags b
 where bag_code = :default_bags.bag_code
 and nvl(blood_type,'XNULLX') = nvl(:default_bags.blood_type,'XNULLX')
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and program_id != t_prog
 and exists (select 'x' from drives d
 where d.drive_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date
 and d.status <> 'CANCL'
 and decode(d.drive_type,'I','C',d.drive_type)
 like decode(:ctrl_blk_1.drive_type,'M','C','F','F','%')
 and b.chapter_id = d.chapter_id
 and b.drive_id = d.drive_id);
BEGIN
 d_list := null;
 select count(*), max(sysdate) into t_cnt, t_date
 from drives d, drive_bags b
 where d.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and d.drive_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date
 and decode(d.drive_type,'I','C',d.drive_type)
 like decode(:ctrl_blk_1.drive_type,'M','C','F','F','%')
 and d.status <> 'CANCL'
 and b.chapter_id = d.chapter_id
 and b.drive_id = d.drive_id
 and b.program_id = t_prog;

 if t_cnt != 0 then
 t_overwrite := show_alert('default_alert');
 if t_overwrite = ALERT_BUTTON3 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif t_overwrite = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 delete from drive_bags b
 where program_id = t_prog
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and exists (select 'x' from drives d
 where d.drive_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date
 and d.status <> 'CANCL'
 and decode(d.drive_type,'I','C',d.drive_type)
 like decode(:ctrl_blk_1.drive_type,'M','C','F','F','%')
 and b.chapter_id = d.chapter_id
 and b.drive_id = d.drive_id);
 end if;
 end if;

 go_record('1');
 check_package_failure;
 loop
 if :default_bags.bag_code is not null then
 begin
 insert into drive_bags
 (chapter_id, drive_id, bag_code, blood_type,
 quantity,insert_user,insert_date,program_id)
 select d.chapter_id, d.drive_id,
 :default_bags.bag_code, :default_bags.blood_type,
 round(d.projected_draw*:default_bags.percentage/100),
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,t_date,t_prog
 from drives d
 where d.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and d.drive_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date
 and d.status <> 'CANCL'
 and decode(d.drive_type,'I','C',d.drive_type)
 like decode(:ctrl_blk_1.drive_type,'M','C','F','F','%')
 and not exists (select 'x' from drive_bags b
 where b.chapter_id = d.chapter_id
 and b.drive_id = d.drive_id
 and b.program_id = t_prog
 and b.insert_date < t_date)
 and not exists (select 'x' from drive_bags b
 where bag_code = :default_bags.bag_code
 and nvl(blood_type,'XNULLX') = nvl(:default_bags.blood_type,'XNULLX')
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and b.drive_id = d.drive_id);
 exception
 when dup_val_on_index then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 for rec in not_updated loop
 d_list := ltrim(substr(d_list||', '||rec.drive_id,1,150),',');
 end loop;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 if d_list is not null then
 show_error('11089',d_list);
 end if;
END;

declare
 msg number;
begin
 select count(msg_id)
 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;
